# AUR Response Toolkit

AUR Response Toolkit is a defensive command-line toolkit for read-only inspection and incident response around Arch User Repository packages. Treat scan results as evidence to review, not as authority to execute or remove content.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/aur-response-toolkit/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/aur-response-toolkit/architecture.html
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/aur-response-toolkit/changelog/

## Source
